notes: 「工作区显示」卡片改成整卡一个「修改」按钮：点它进入编辑态，所有工作区三态与会话显隐一起解锁，再点「完成」退出；不再每个工作区各带一个按钮。同时把会话与按钮的对应关系做实：编辑态下每条会话占一行、整行加底色并带分隔线，开关就贴在该行右侧，按钮文案与颜色区分「隐藏/显示」，隐藏的会话名加删除线。
notesEn: The "Workspace visibility" card now has a single Edit button for the whole card: click it to unlock every workspace state and every session toggle, then click Done to leave. The per-workspace buttons are gone. Session/button pairing is also clearer — in edit mode each session gets its own row with a background and a divider, the toggle sits at the end of that row, and the button word plus colour tells you Hide vs Show; hidden sessions get a strikethrough name.
